readinessPolicy.READY: Planning-eligible only; live Task Queue/Session/locks/main must still be reobserved before runtime materialization.

readinessPolicy.CONDITIONAL: Never auto-promote; requires all explicit human/governance gates.
readinessPolicy.completionRule: A blueprint completion updates/checkpoints evidence first, then only direct dependents are re-evaluated.
